notes.title: NEW UPDATE: Alpha Zombie is here!
notes.content:
Have you been groundlessly eliminated or betrayed by your mates?? Now you're able to recruit zombies nearby and coordinate efforts to attack players or ruin Shelter walls!
[img]https://bitten.by/static/media/alpha-zombie.536fa4c9.gif[/img]

In this update also we've added two additional languages: 
[list]
[*] Spanish
[*] Turkish (thanks [url=https://www.twitch.tv/burakbek]Burak BEK[/url])!
[/list]
